data.name: AlFaruk
data.gender_notes: AlFaruk is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The one who covers, hides, or protects
data.long_meaning: The one who covers, hides, or protects, derived from the Arabic root ‘afaraka’ which means ‘to hide, cover, or protect’. This name is associated with the concept of safety, security, and the strength of a lion. The name AlFaruk carries the meaning “The one who covers, hides, or protects” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose AlFaruk usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who covers, hides, or protects and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: AlFaruk is a name of Allah which means ‘The One Who Hides or Conceals’ and is mentioned in the Quran (13:10). It is believed that Allah hides the sins of believers and reveals their virtues.
data.etymology: AlFaruk belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The one who covers, hides, or protects.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlFaruk total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: الفرك
in_arabic.meaning: الذي يفرق بين الحق والباطل، العادل في الحكم
in_arabic.long_meaning: الفرك هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الذي يفرق بين الحق والباطل، العادل في الحكم، وهو من أسماء الله التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، ويستخدم في الإسلام كاسم لله تعالى، كما يستخدم كاسم شخصي للدلالة على العدل والإنصاف

in_english.name: AlFaruk
in_english.meaning: The one who distinguishes between right and wrong, the just
in_english.long_meaning: AlFaruk is an Arabic name derived from the root 'F-R-Q', which means to distinguish or separate. It is one of the names of Allah in Islam, signifying the one who differentiates between right and wrong, truth and falsehood. This name is mentioned in the Quran and is associated with justice and fairness. In Islamic tradition, AlFaruk is also a notable epithet of the second caliph, Umar ibn Al-Khattab, reflecting his ability to make just decisions. The name AlFaruk conveys the attributes of justice, discernment, and righteousness

data.cultural_impact: The name AlFaruk is rooted in Arabic Islamic culture and has historical significance, especially during the time of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). One of the personal names of the Prophet's grandsons, Al-Hasan Ibn Ali, was AlFaruk. This historical connection adds a level of importance to the name and a sense of pride for those who bear it.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, 'AlFaruk' is considered God's servant who shields, protects, and covers the believer from harm. The name has significant relevance for those who follow Islam as it embodies the essence of the belief system in caring for others.
